title: SK Hynix and the Korean government plan to partner on building Trinity Fab, a new $654M chip testing facility letting suppliers test products on 12-inch wafers (Yoolim Lee/Bloomberg)
summary: Yoolim Lee / Bloomberg: SK Hynix and the Korean government plan to partner on building Trinity Fab, a new $654M chip testing facility letting suppliers test products on 12-inch wafers — SK Hynix Inc. plans to open a semiconductor testing facility next year in partnership with the Korean government …
